## What changes and why?

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and a concrete example. Link a related
issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks performed and their results. State any remaining
limits. For behavior changes, include relevant input identity, unknown-state and
patch/recovery cases.

## Documentation and evidence

- [ ] User-facing text and maintained guides have English and Chinese counterparts,
      or this change does not affect them.
- [ ] Frozen evidence and original licenses retain their bytes; new evidence has
      a new identity where applicable.
- [ ] Shared fixtures and logs contain no credentials or private research material.
